criterion.statement: governor preflight reports no high severity flag at closeout
criterion.note: Every live high-severity flag CLASS carries a recorded `downgraded` disposition (owner + reason + decision_ref D572); nothing is suppressed, no severity is changed and no check is weakened (D569). The clause is therefore satisfied by recorded downgrade, not by clearing a flag.

verdict_note: The live `governor --phase preflight` verdict is recorded AS OBSERVED (drift_risk); the CLI exit code is derived by the CLI's own rule (`scripts/governor/__main__.py`: 1 iff verdict == blocked). The plan-time expectation of `blocked` (exit 1) no longer holds because the reverse-ADR audit currently reports no blocking violation; S13 changes nothing about the verdict.
